title: Pre-dive checks & recovery
provisional: Pulse tests are simulated diagnostics, 2 s each; do not throw the vehicle.
provisionalDetail: Power-on order, chimes, lamp cues and recovery speed are provisional pending field measurement.
checks: Tether connector and locking collar confirmed
Shore power and vehicle power-on confirmed
In water, clear of personnel before arming — confirmed
skip: Skip unfinished checks (may cause faults and penalties)
tender: Confirm the tether tender is ready
lower: Pick an upstream point and lower into the water on the tether
water: Video, trim and functions OK; personnel clear
recoverReady: Disarm at the surface, then reel in and recover
recoverDepth: Surface within 0.8 m before reeling in for recovery.
recoverLock: Disarm before reeling in for recovery.
surfacedReady: Back at the surface · Open the pause menu to reel in and recover
surfacedLock: Back at the surface · Disarm, then recover from the pause menu
fault: An unchecked item failed; penalty applied. Abort and reel in if needed.
dry: Ran dry for over 30 s; alarm raised and penalty applied.
recovering: Reeling in; current and simulated sea state slow recovery
onDeck: Vehicle is on the workboat aft deck, not yet in the water; finish checks, lower in and confirm before arming.
